## 2026-01-24 - Enhancing Automated Markdown Reports
**Learning:** Automated reports (like from `analytics.py`) often lack navigability. Adding a simple Table of Contents with anchors and "Back to Top" links significantly improves usability for long documents, even in plain Markdown.
**Action:** Always include auto-generated navigation (TOC + anchors) for any CLI tool that outputs long-form Markdown content.
